  filter(!Site %in% c(\MSL\, \MSTR1\, \MSU\, \RT0\))

elements <- read_csv(\data/Periodic Table of Elements.csv\) %>% select(Symbol, AtomicMass)

```r
data_long <- data %>% select(Date,Site, Reach, Dist, Na_ppb, Mg_ppb, 
                             Al_ppb, Si_ppb, K_ppb, Ca_ppb, Fe_ppb,
                             S_ppm_as_SO4) %>%
  pivot_longer(Na_ppb:S_ppm_as_SO4) %>%
  mutate(Element = substr(name, 1, nchar(name) - 4)) %>%
  left_join(elements, by = c(\Element\ = \Symbol\)) %>%
  mutate(mol_L = (value / 1000000) / AtomicMass)

data_wide_molL <- data_long %>% select(Site, Reach, Dist, Element, mol_L) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = mol_L, names_from = Element)

data_long %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Reach, y = value, fill = Date))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scale = \free\)+
  theme_classic()
```

```r


# Create a data frame defining the three regions
regions <- data.frame(
  region = c("Evaporites", "Silicates", "Carbonates"),
  xmin = c(0.12, 0.22, 20),
  xmax = c(.28,   0.65,   80),
  ymin = c(0.015, 0.18, 6),
  ymax = c(0.05,  0.65,   10)
)

data_wide_molL |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Ca / Na, y = Mg / Na, color = Reach))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
   # Draw rectangular regions
  geom_rect(data = regions,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
                ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                fill = region),
            alpha = 0.2,
            color = "black",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add labels centered in each region
  geom_text(data = regions,
            aes(x = sqrt(xmin * xmax),
                y = sqrt(ymin * ymax),
                label = region),
            size = 5,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Log scales
  scale_x_log10(name = "Ca/Na",
                limits = c(0.1, 100)) +
  scale_y_log10(name = "Mg/Na",
                limits = c(0.01, 10)) 
  


ggplot() +
  
  # Draw rectangular regions
  geom_rect(data = regions,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
                ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                fill = region),
            alpha = 0.2,
            color = "black") +
  
  # Add labels centered in each region
  geom_text(data = regions,
            aes(x = sqrt(xmin * xmax),
                y = sqrt(ymin * ymax),
                label = region),
            size = 5) +
  
  # Log scales
  scale_x_log10(name = "Ca/Na",
                limits = c(0.1, 100)) +
  scale_y_log10(name = "Mg/Na",
                limits = c(0.01, 10)) +
  
  # Clean theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
